info.name: Consents Account On File Account Controls (New) Account Controls (New) Bank API

params.name: customer_id
params.description: Scopes the returned banks to those enabled for the given customer. Used to control bank rollout on a per-customer basis, so that newly onboarded banks can be exposed to selected customers before being made generally available.

params.name: bank_type
params.description: Specifies whether the Entity is a Retail or Corporate owned account.

params.name: account_types
params.description: Filters the results to banks that support at least one of the specified account types.

params.name: country_codes
params.description: Filters the results to banks located in the specified countries. Values must be alpha-3 (3 character) ISO 3166 country codes.

params.name: connection_types
params.description: Filters the results to banks that use one of the specified connection types.

items.docs: Fetch a list of all supported Banks for your application, includes status and configuration information.
